Name: Loan Mod
Author: legovader09
Description:
[size=3][b]Working in 1.6 with latest SMAPI version!
[/b][/size]
Just wanted to say that this is my first mod so feedback is very much welcome!
I haven't been able to extensively test it, so if you find any errors, please let me know.

[b][size=3]What is Loan Mod?[/size]
[/b]Loan Mod is a mod that lets you loan money for a period of time, with daily repayment installments. From interest rates, to the duration of the loan, almost everything can be customised; either via the config.json file or via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod.

[b][size=3]Installation[/size][/b][list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install Loan Mod.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Using the Mod[/size][/b][list]
[*]Using the mod is very straight-forward! Simply press L, or open the app on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] mod.
[*]You will be then prompted with an input of how much money you would like to borrow, and the duration you would like to borrow for along with the interest amount for that time period.
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: By default, the shorter the loan is the higher the interest rate will be, however some people prefer this the other way around. If this is the case for you, I'd recommend changing the interest rate values accordingly. The interest value corresponds to the DayLength setting, so [i]DayLength1[/i] matches with [i]InterestModifier1[/i], and so on.

Pressing "L" again while already borrowing gives you the options of showing your balance, the amount of days you have left and the repayment amount per day, it also gives you the option to repay any outstanding balance in full.

[size=3][b]Late Payment Charges[/b][/size]
By default, there is a 10% late payment charge, this can be changed in the config file. If you do not want late payment fees, simply set this to [b]0[/b].

The late payment charge works as follows:
[*]If a payment is missed by one day, a warning message will be issued, notifying that further delays will result in charges.
[*]If payments are missed for two or more days, a late fee of 10% (configurable) of the total remaining balance will be applied and added to the balance.
